labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Rich strips \r on purpose; overwriting a line is a usage question answered by Live.

items.body:
Rich strips carriage returns (`\r`) from printed text on purpose, so `rich.print()` cannot be used to overwrite a line the way the built-in `print()` can. Flushing only controls when output is written, not whether `\r` is kept.

To redraw a line in place, use a live display. The [Live docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst) show how to update a renderable repeatedly, and `Progress` and `console.status()` cover common cases.

For general usage questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
